verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Shortcut's REST API, MCP server and plan features, but nothing documents API rate limits, automation quotas, or what happens on overage (extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop). The workflow-state story limits are WIP controls, an adjacent feature that does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know what happens—extra charges, throttling, or a hard stop—when I exceed my plan's automation or API call limits
